ENGLISH LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'rinse' mean in the passage on hand washing? (1 mark)
   A. To wash off soap with clean water
   B. To hide germs
   C. To dry the hands
   D. To add soap

2. What does a dictionary give? (1 mark)
   A. The meaning and spelling of words
   B. A map of Kenya
   C. News about sports
   D. A list of names of people

3. What is the full set of coordinating conjunctions? (1 mark)
   A. he, she, it, we, you, they, I
   B. if, when, while, since, until, unless, after
   C. for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so
   D. in, on, at, by, to, from, with

4. Which paragraph plan is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Conclusion, details, introduction
   B. Introduction, details, conclusion
   C. Conclusion only
   D. Details only

5. Which sentence uses the sense of touch? (1 mark)
   A. The soup tasted sweet.
   B. We heard laughter.
   C. The room is bright.
   D. The towel is soft and dry.

6. What is athletics? (1 mark)
   A. A type of food
   B. Only football
   C. Sports such as running, jumping and throwing
   D. A kind of card game

7. Which word has the sound /aʊ/? (1 mark)
   A. hot
   B. crowd
   C. bell
   D. cat

8. Why should you not click on strange pop-up advertisements? (1 mark)
   A. They may be unsafe
   B. They improve your reading
   C. They are always free prizes
   D. They are required by the teacher

9. Which is a fact that can be checked? (1 mark)
   A. Netball is the nicest game.
   B. Netball is boring.
   C. A netball team has seven players.
   D. Everyone should play netball.

10. Which is the best answer to 'Where is the stadium?' (1 mark)
   A. The captain.
   B. At three o'clock.
   C. Hers.
   D. It is near the town.

11. Which day is spelt correctly? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Wednsday
   C. Wensday
   D. Wenesday

12. Which word begins with the cluster 'sw'? (1 mark)
   A. green
   B. sweep
   C. broom
   D. clean

13. Which words rhyme? (1 mark)
   A. clean and sweep
   B. tree and tall
   C. green and grass
   D. green and clean

14. What is the past participle of 'write'? (1 mark)
   A. writing
   B. written
   C. wrote
   D. writed

15. Which sentence is in the present perfect? (1 mark)
   A. She will finish.
   B. She has finished.
   C. She was finishing.
   D. She finishes.

16. Which word can help you show the order of events in a diary? (1 mark)
   A. desk
   B. then
   C. green
   D. broom

17. In the telephone game, why is careful listening important? (1 mark)
   A. There is nothing to hear
   B. The message can change as it is passed on
   C. The game is silent
   D. The first player wins by shouting

18. Which preposition shows movement to the inside? (1 mark)
   A. behind
   B. into
   C. on
   D. beside

19. Which word means 'jumping on one leg'? (1 mark)
   A. hopping
   B. hopped
   C. hopeing
   D. hoping

20. What is the -ing form of 'stop'? (1 mark)
   A. stoping
   B. stopeing
   C. stopping
   D. stoppping

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the -ing form of: run, sit, swim. (3 marks)

22. Write a diary entry of about 60 words about a day at school. Include the date, feelings and a plan for tomorrow. (5 marks)

23. Write the past participle of: write, see, take. (3 marks)

24. Cross out the silent letter in each word: write, lamb, honest, listen. (2 marks)

25. Explain why flies are dangerous to health. (2 marks)

26. Give two words with /θ/ and two with /ð/. (4 marks)

27. Write the minimal pairs for: ship, seat, sock. (3 marks)

28. Draw a mind map in words: put 'Keeping Fit' in the centre and give four branches. (4 marks)

29. Write four sentences to advise classmates on keeping the school toilets clean. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — To wash off soap with clean water
   You rinse after soap.

2. A — The meaning and spelling of words
   Dictionary words are in alphabetical order.

3. C — for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so
   The seven are remembered as FANBOYS.

4. B — Introduction, details, conclusion
   Descriptions usually run from an introduction through details to a conclusion.

5. D — The towel is soft and dry.
   'Soft and dry' describes how it feels.

6. C — Sports such as running, jumping and throwing
   Athletics includes track and field events.

7. B — crowd
   'Crowd' has the diphthong /aʊ/, as in 'cow'.

8. A — They may be unsafe
   Strange links can be unsafe.

9. C — A netball team has seven players.
   A fact can be checked; the others are opinions.

10. D — It is near the town.
   'Where' asks for a place.

11. A — Wednesday
   Wednesday is spelt Wed-nes-day.

12. B — sweep
   'Sweep' begins with s and w.

13. D — green and clean
   'Green' and 'clean' end with the same sound.

14. B — written
   Write, wrote, written.

15. B — She has finished.
   Has + past participle.

16. B — then
   'Then' is a time word.

17. B — The message can change as it is passed on
   The last player may hear a different message.

18. B — into
   'Into' shows movement from outside to inside.

19. A — hopping
   Hopping has a double p; hoping means wishing.

20. C — stopping
   Double the last consonant of a short verb ending in one vowel and one consonant.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: running, sitting, swimming
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: An entry in the first person with a date, events in order, feelings, a plan and a sign-off.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the date, 1 for events in order, 1 for feelings, 1 for a plan, 1 for correct tense and punctuation.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: written, seen, taken
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: write (w), lamb (b), honest (h), listen (t)
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Flies land on waste and then on food, so they carry germs to the food we eat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for waste then food and 1 mark for germs spreading.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: /θ/: think, three, thank, mouth (any two). /ð/: this, that, the, mother (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: ship and sheep (or sip); seat and sheet (or sit); sock and shock.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct partner word.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Centre: Keeping Fit. Branches: exercise, healthy food, sleep, clean water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the centre and 1 for each branch.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands with soap after using the toilet. Do not throw rubbish in the latrine. Keep the door closed. Tell the teacher about any damage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible sentence.
